summary: EFCAR, LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3, issuing ~$1.127B in asset-backed notes across multiple tranches (Class A-1 through D publicly offered, Class E and N privately placed). No special-situation event; it is a routine structured finance securitization of sub-prime auto loans. Credit enhancement includes excess cashflow, overcollateralization, subordination, and a reserve account. Distributions begin July 15, 2026. No merger, acquisition, activist, or restructuring involved.
